properties.name: light-boot.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Allowed origins for cross-origin requests. Secure default is an empty list (no origins allowed) — must be configured explicitly. Examples: "*", "https://example.com", "http://localhost:3000". Cannot use "*" when allow-credentials is true.

properties.name: light-boot.cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: Allowed HTTP methods. Common: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS.

properties.name: light-boot.cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: Allowed request headers. Use "*" for all headers, or specify: "Content-Type", "Authorization".

properties.name: light-boot.cors.exposed-headers
properties.description: Exposed response headers accessible by browsers. Common: "Content-Disposition", "Authorization", "X-Total-Count".

properties.name: light-boot.cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: Allow credentials (cookies, auth headers). When true, must use explicit origins (no "*").

properties.name: light-boot.cors.max-age
properties.description: Preflight response cache time in seconds. Dev: 60-300s, Prod: 3600s (1 hour).

properties.name: light-boot.cors.path-pattern
properties.description: URL path pattern for CORS configuration. Default: "/**" (all paths).

properties.name: light-boot.cors.enabled
properties.description: Enable CORS auto-configuration. Default false (must be explicitly enabled); when false, neither the MVC CorsConfigurer nor the Security CorsFilter bean is registered. Set true to enable framework-managed CORS.

properties.name: light-boot.async.executor.core-pool-size
properties.description: Core pool size. Note: with the default allow-core-thread-time-out=true, idle core threads are reclaimed after keep-alive-seconds (not kept alive forever). CPU-bound: CPU cores; IO-bound: CPU cores x 2.

properties.name: light-boot.async.executor.max-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum pool size - must be >= corePoolSize. CPU-bound: same as corePoolSize; IO-bound: CPU cores x 4+.

properties.name: light-boot.async.executor.queue-capacity
properties.description: Queue capacity - max tasks waiting for execution. Small (100-500): faster rejection, lower memory. Large (1000+): better throughput, higher memory.

properties.name: light-boot.async.executor.keep-alive-seconds
properties.description: Idle thread timeout in seconds. Affects non-core threads unless allowCoreThreadTimeOut is enabled.

properties.name: light-boot.async.executor.thread-name-prefix
properties.description: Thread name prefix for identification (e.g., "async-executor-1").

properties.name: light-boot.async.executor.allow-core-thread-time-out
properties.description: Whether core threads can timeout during idle periods. True: lower resource usage, slight latency spike on ramp-up. False: consistent performance, higher baseline usage.

properties.name: light-boot.async.executor.await-termination-seconds
properties.description: Max seconds to wait for tasks during graceful shutdown. Short tasks: 30-60s; Long tasks: 120-300s.

properties.name: light-boot.scheduling.thread-pool.pool-size
properties.description: Thread pool size for scheduled tasks. Light scheduling: 2-5, Moderate: 5-10, Heavy: 10-20.

properties.name: light-boot.scheduling.thread-pool.thread-name-prefix
properties.description: Thread name prefix for identification (e.g., "scheduled-task-1").

properties.name: light-boot.scheduling.thread-pool.wait-for-tasks-to-complete-on-shutdown
properties.description: Whether to wait for tasks to complete during graceful shutdown. When true, the scheduler will wait for running tasks to finish before allowing the application to fully shut down.

properties.name: light-boot.scheduling.thread-pool.await-termination-seconds
properties.description: Maximum seconds to wait for tasks during graceful shutdown. Recommended: 30-60 seconds for most scheduled tasks.

properties.name: light-boot.web.http-status.enabled
properties.description: Whether exception responses carry real HTTP status codes (400/401/403/404/429/500). Default true; set false to revert to HTTP 200 for all responses (legacy behavior).
